svg.title: Conway Twitty's Game of Life — seeded from my contribution graph
svg.text: GEN 000 · CONTRIBUTION MAP LOADED — EVERY GREEN SQUARE IS A LIVING CELL
GEN 50 · Fifty multiplications and no sign of settling down. Your cells have clearly found their duty cycle — and it's aggressive.
GEN 100 · 100 multiplications. Your MAC unit is doing multiply-and-ACCUMULATE in front of everyone, and nobody's complaining.
GEN 150 · 150 generations of sustained oscillation. Somebody should check the thermal budget, because it is getting hot in here.
GEN 200 · Gain > 1 with positive feedback — the textbook definition of 'things escalating quickly.'
STEADY STATE AT GEN 254 — the survivors formed still lifes and oscillators: technically alive, allergic to change. Like legacy code.
RULE B3/S23 — no relation to the country singer, though both fill a board with hits.
Every green square from my contribution graph is a living cell. Fewer than 2 neighbors: dies of underpopulation — nobody to pair-program with.
More than 3: dies of thermal throttling. Exactly 3: a new cell is born, and we don't ask questions.
The edges wrap, because all good universes are toruses.
SEED 0xB399671B · REFRESHED DAILY · TORUS TOPOLOGY · GENESIS NODE @ WK 10 · SAT · SEU EVENTS: 6 · RAD-HARD: NO
